title: When Bitcoin’s rally meets LISTA’s surprise party
content: Bitcoin’s up 4.7% and I’m already day‑trading the 1‑minute chart. Then LISTA spikes 16.6% and my brain goes: ‘Did I just miss the meme coin lottery or is this a trap?’
lesson: Set a max‑drawdown alarm before you chase any 15% pop – leverage loves to bite back.
question: Who else saw LISTA explode and instantly regretted not setting a stop‑loss? Be honest 👇
